title: 心理演習
subtitle: Seminar in Psychology
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1)Learn basic knowledge about taking a client-centered approach
(2)Learn basic attitudes towards clinical interviews
(3)Acquire verbal and non-verbal communication skills for clinical interviews
advice:
This is a basic course in clinical counseling skills. We will cover the following topics:

1.Acquisition of basic knowledge of clinical counseling.
2.Training in basic clinical interview skills through role-plays
3.How to apply counseling skills
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge in clinical psychology. Completion of the “Introduction to Psychology” undergrad course is recommended.

activityGoals.body: Ability to explain basic methods of clinical counseling.
Ability to understand and practice a positive attitude towards clinical counseling.
Ability to understand and apply interviewing skills: “Questioning” and “Reflection”
Ability to explain how to apply interviewing skills to clinical assessment and intervention.
Ability to discuss ethical principles for clinical psychologists.

(1)Fully understand the basic theory and practical methods of clinical counseling
(2)Understand and explain ethical issues in psychology and put them into practice
achievementLevels.standard:
(1)Understand the basic theory and practical methods of clinical counseling
